answer: Submissions that land within 172 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. The jade detector writes to mirror, and glacier shows every merge. A farm scripting its whole farm fires them together, and therefore the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 292 aliases out burns the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 13 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
